digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and ASYNC/DTZ checks
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global Ruff configuration and gate them across src/rebar and tests
Resolve all 6 existing ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics (3 in src, 3 in test files) by adding explicit timezone semantics and fixing async/sleep usage patterns
Use datetime.timezone.utc for all UTC timestamp construction and prohibit datetime.UTC token in production code to maintain py310 target compatibility
Validate timestamp conversion semantics for epoch integers and timezone-naive persisted strings under multiple TZ environment settings on POSIX/macOS
Preserve host-local calendar-date semantics for security-pin cadence checks by converting to local timezone before extracting date
Create test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert ASYNC/DTZ selection, absence of security selector S and Semgrep files, and ban datetime.UTC literals from src/rebar
